VERIFY checked. 7 × 26 = 182 and 7 × 20 + 7 × 6 = 140 + 42 = 182, so the marked choice is correct. The distractors are wrong: 7 × 2 + 7 × 6 = 56 and 7 × 20 + 6 = 146.
